location.title: Location
location.description: Free-text place name to geocode (e.g. "Yosemite Valley, California"). Ignored if `coordinates` is set.

coordinates.title: Coordinates (optional)
coordinates.description: Coordinates that override `location` and skip geocoding when set. Accepts decimal ("37.7456, -119.5936"), decimal with hemisphere ("37.7456 N, 119.5936 W"), degrees decimal minutes ("N 37° 44.736, W 119° 35.616"), or degrees minutes seconds ("37°44'44\"N 119°35'37\"W"). Hemisphere letters may come before or after the number and may be given on just one of the two components ("37.7456 N, -119.5936" — the bare number takes the remaining axis and keeps its own sign); separate the two with a comma or whitespace. A colon may stand in for the degree sign.
